issue.standard_remedy: Harmonize prices to the best plant / global agreement
issue.summary: Pays 5.5% on average above the best plant for the same materials

plan.diagnosis: Monterrey plant pays a 5.5% average premium versus best-plant pricing for 237 materials sourced from Meridian Industrial Mexico through SAP ECC 6.0, resulting in USD 1,288,495 excess annual spend. Root cause is lack of price harmonization and absence of centralized contract governance across the SAP instance.

remedy_steps.step: Conduct joint business review with Meridian Industrial Mexico to benchmark Monterrey pricing against best-plant rates for all 237 materials and negotiate price alignment to eliminate the 5.5% premium
Establish master purchasing agreement in SAP ECC 6.0 with harmonized pricing for the 237 materials, enforceable across Monterrey and all other plants sourcing from Meridian Industrial Mexico
Update SAP info records (EINE) for Monterrey plant to reflect negotiated best-plant pricing and lock conditions to prevent local price deviations
Implement SAP source list (EORD) entries designating the master agreement as the sole approved source for the 237 materials at Monterrey, with source determination enforcement
Deploy monthly variance reporting comparing Monterrey actual pricing versus master agreement targets for all Meridian Industrial Mexico materials, escalating deviations >2%

plan.expected_impact: Price harmonization will eliminate the 5.5% premium on 237 materials, capturing USD 1,288,495 in annual savings.
kpis: Percentage of 237 materials priced at or below best-plant baseline (target: 100% by Week 6)
Average price premium reduction from 5.5% baseline (target: 0% by Week 6)
Realized savings vs. USD 1,288,495 target (monthly tracking)
Number of Monterrey POs issued outside master agreement (target: 0)
risks: Meridian Industrial Mexico may resist price reductions, citing local cost factors or service levels unique to Monterrey; require cost transparency and benchmarking
SAP master data quality issues or incomplete info record coverage for all 237 materials may delay enforcement
Local Monterrey procurement team may bypass controls via one-time vendors or manual POs if not trained on new sourcing requirements
Volume commitments required for best-plant pricing may exceed Monterrey's current run-rate, necessitating multi-plant aggregation
erp_actions: SAP ECC 6.0: Create or update 237 info records (ME12) for Monterrey plant with negotiated best-plant net prices, validity dates, and price condition lock

SAP ECC 6.0: Establish source list entries (ME01) for all 237 materials at Monterrey plant, designating master agreement vendor record with source list requirement indicator (ME03 - tick 'Source list requirement' in material master MRP2 view)
SAP ECC 6.0: Set up release strategy for Monterrey POs sourcing these 237 materials if price exceeds info record by >1% (ME28 condition-based release)
SAP ECC 6.0: Configure output message (NAST) to alert Regional Procurement Lead for any PO line exceeding best-plant benchmark price
SAP ECC 6.0: Create vendor master record (XK02) note documenting master agreement terms and USD 1,288,495 savings target for audit trail
